instruction: Pick the hamburg with white and orange and the Crispy potato fries with red box, then place them on the medium green tray for carrying.

source.instruction: Pick the hamburg with white and orange and the Crispy potato fries with red box, then place them on the medium green tray for carrying.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the hamburg, which was at x = -26 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the frenchfries, which was at x = +23 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper above the hamburger at (-25.5, -12, 85) pointing down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+5, +7, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the hamburg

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -13, 85) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above the fries at (23, -11.5, 85) pointing down.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-8, +7, -9) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the frenchfries

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-25, -13, 85) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -12, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper down to z=77.5 to grasp hamburger.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the hamburg

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-26, -12, 78) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -12, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to z=77.5 and close both grippers to grasp both items.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the hamburg; closed the gripper (opening 0.71: holding the hamburg); RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -7) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the frenchfries; closed the gripper (opening 0.58: holding the frenchfries)

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-26, -12, 78) opening 0.71; RIGHT fingertips (23, -11, 78) opening 0.58; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift both grippers up by 10 cm to clear table level.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the hamburg; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the frenchfries

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-26, -12, 87) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (22, -11, 87) opening 0.60; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm with hamburger rightward over left side of tray around (-7.5, -12, 88).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+18, +0, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the hamburg

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -12, 88) opening 0.70; RIGHT fingertips (22, -11, 87) opening 0.60; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm by 8 cm to z=80 and open gripper to release hamburger.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the hamburg; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -12, 80) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (22, -11, 87) opening 0.60; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm back to z=88 clear of the hamburger.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, +8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the hamburg

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -12, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (22, -11, 87) opening 0.60; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract left arm to home and move right arm over right side of tray to (6.5, -12, 87.5).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-23, -8, +6) cm, now 24 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the hamburg; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-15, -1, +0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the frenchfries

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (7, -12, 88) opening 0.59; table z = 74
frames.plan: Make fine adjustment to right arm height before releasing.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the frenchfries

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (7, -12, 87) opening 0.59; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm down to z=79 and release fries onto the tray.
